Name: Clean Maps
Author: Amichwan
Description:
[b]Clean Maps[/b]
Clean and declutter multiple areas across the valley.
This mod removes unnecessary rocks, debris, decorations, and obstacles to create more open and usable spaces throughout the game.

[b][u]Main Features[/u][/b]
• [b]Map Cleanups:[/b]
◦ SPA: Removes wall cracks and dirt
◦ Beach: Removes the wooden planks on the upper area
▪ In vanilla maps, the wooden planks in the upper-left corner are preserved to maintain progression and are removed after Community upgrades
◦ Ginger Island Farm: Removes the wooden planks at the bottom of the farm while keeping a hint for the Golden Walnut
◦ Forest Trash: Removes the trash left in the lower forest areas after the bear event
◦ Coop & Barn Interiors: Removes decorations, broken walls, and straw from the floor
◦ Movie Theater: Removes some wall cracks
◦ Quarry: Removes rocks blocking the edges and pathways
◦ Cellar: Repairs the damaged floor
◦ Greenhouse: Removes edge decorations
◦ Stable: Restores the stable to a cleaner, undamaged appearance
◦ Animal Waterer: Toggle Barn Water Troughs on or off independently from the clean trough appearance option
◦ Animal Waterer Clean: Removes the rusty appearance


• [b]Fully Configurable:[/b] Every cleanup option can be individually enabled or disabled through GMCM.

[b][u]Compatibility[/u][/b]
• [b]SVE Compatible:[/b] Includes compatibility support for Stardew Valley Expanded.
◦ Adds an option to enable or disable SVE mist effects on maps.
